{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for loyal customers, exclude QA orders (revenue = 999999.99), and exclude refunded orders
loyal_valid = df[(df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & 
                  (df['revenue'] != 999999.99) & 
                  (df['status'] != 'refunded')]

# Compute the conversion fraction
n_loyal_valid = loyal_valid.shape[0]
converted_loyal_valid = loyal_valid['converted'].sum()
conversion_fraction = converted_loyal_valid / n_loyal_valid

# Print all required values
print(f'n_loyal_valid: {n_loyal_valid}')
print(f'converted_loyal_valid: {converted_loyal_valid}')
print(f'conversion_fraction: {conversion_fraction}')"}
